standard_prerequisites.use: The terminal base case: constructibility of R^qf_*Z/lZ for the proper smooth family of curves.

core_obligations: Set up the induction on n: for a prime factor l of n form 0 -> M[l] -> M -> M' -> 0 with M' annihilated by n', produce the long exact sequence of R^qf_*, and note the constructible-abelian lemma wins the induction once the prime case is proved (proof lines 4592-4606).
Reduce the coefficient ring: for l annihilating M, view M as a sheaf of Lambda/lLambda-modules; R^qf_*M is unchanged by sites-cohomology-lemma-modules-abelian-unbounded (proof lines 4609-4616).

Reduce M to finite free: take a resolution by finite free Lambda-modules, use the finite cohomological dimension of f_* (with the two derived category lemmas) to truncate the resolution, and conclude via the spectral sequence of the total complex that it suffices to prove R^qf_*Lambda constructible (proof lines 4619-4646).

Trade to the constant sheaf: apply the mod-l projection formula to get R^qf_*Lambda as the tensor of R^qf_*Z/lZ with Lambda (ordinary tensor since modules over the field are flat), conclude by the tensor-constructible lemma, and cite the constant sheaf case lemma (proof lines 4649-4667).
proof_roadmap: Induction on the torsion degree (proof lines 4592-4606).
Coefficient ring reduction to F_l-algebras (proof lines 4609-4616).
Free resolution reduction to the structure sheaf coefficients (proof lines 4619-4646).
Projection formula down to the constant sheaf case (proof lines 4649-4667).
